params.body:
Adds the company film to the Over ons page, directly under the introduction and above the history timeline.

- `public/video/bedrijfsfilm.mp4`: the 48-second cut from the transfer, re-encoded for the web (1280x720, H.264 crf 23, AAC 128k, faststart, the 4-pixel black bands cropped, timecode track dropped). 9 MB instead of 87 MB; a full decode runs clean.
- `public/video/bedrijfsfilm.webp`: poster from the opening shot (the sign at the entrance), 45 KB.
- Native `<video>` with controls, `preload="none"` and no autoplay, so the page only loads the film when someone presses play, with sound. Square edges, 16:9, full content width on desktop and phone.
- Translated `aria-label` in nl, de, en, fr and es.
- `CompanyFilmTest` guards the markup and the files.

Checked locally: 56 tests green; in headless Chromium the film plays (1280x720, no media error) and the layout holds at 1280 px and 390 px.

The short 24-second cut is left out; it is the social-media version.

Closes #31
params.title: Over ons: the company film under the introduction
